turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting fixture diagnostic procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Inspect the fixture base plate for cracks or surface distortion. Check all locating surfaces, dowel holes, and mounting pad faces for damage. Also inspect each clamp body for deformation or cracked pivot pins.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the fixture base plate for cracks or surface distortion. 2. Check locating surfaces, dowel holes, and mounting pad faces for damage. 3. Inspect each clamp body for deformation or cracked pivot pins.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Visual inspection complete. All components checked and documented.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the fixture base plate for cracks or surface distortion. 2. Check locating surfaces, dowel holes, and mounting pad faces for damage. 3. Inspect each clamp body for deformation or cracked pivot pins.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are there any base plate cracks, distortion, or damaged mounting surfaces?

ground_truth.node_text: Base plate cracks, distortion or damaged mounting surfaces?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The base plate looks fine, but I'm noticing significant corrosion around the anchor bolts and the grout underneath seems to be deteriorating pretty badly.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The base plate looks good, no visible cracks or distortion detected.

ground_truth.node_text: Base plate cracks, distortion or damaged mounting surfaces?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the datum A surface within flatness tolerance of 0.02 millimeters?

ground_truth.node_text: Datum A surface within flatness tolerance of 0.02 mm?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The flatness measurement shows 0.028 millimeters deviation, which exceeds the tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Datum A surface within flatness tolerance of 0.02 mm?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Scrape or regrind the datum A surface to restore flatness to specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Scrape or regrind datum A surface to restore flatness

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Datum A surface has been reground and flatness restored.

ground_truth.node_text: Scrape or regrind datum A surface to restore flatness

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Locate the probe stylus against the primary locating pin at three heights along the pin axis. Record the pin position in X and Y relative to the fixture datum origin and compare against nominal.

ground_truth.node_text: Locate the probe stylus against the primary locating pin at three heights along the pin axis. Record the pin position in X and Y relative to the fixture datum origin. Compare the measured position against the nominal position on the fixture design drawing; deviation greater than the tolerance stated in the process control plan requires fixture withdrawal for repair.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Primary pin measurements recorded at all three heights and compared to design drawing.

ground_truth.node_text: Locate the probe stylus against the primary locating pin at three heights along the pin axis. Record the pin position in X and Y relative to the fixture datum origin. Compare the measured position against the nominal position on the fixture design drawing; deviation greater than the tolerance stated in the process control plan requires fixture withdrawal for repair.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are the primary locating pins within plus or minus 0.01 millimeters of nominal position?

ground_truth.node_text: Primary locating pins within ±0.01 mm of nominal position?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all primary pin positions are within tolerance at 0.007 millimeters deviation.

ground_truth.node_text: Primary locating pins within ±0.01 mm of nominal position?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are the secondary locating pins within plus or minus 0.015 millimeters of nominal?

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary locating pins within ±0.015 mm of nominal?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The secondary pins are reading okay, but I'm noticing the hydraulic clamp pressure gauge is fluctuating between 45 and 60 PSI when it should be steady at 55.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Secondary pins measure within spec at 0.012 millimeters offset.

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary locating pins within ±0.015 mm of nominal?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are all Z height reference pads within plus or minus 0.01 millimeters of each other?

ground_truth.node_text: All Z height reference pads within ±0.01 mm of each other?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Hey, before I check that, do you know if the PM schedule for the chiller system got updated last week? I need to log my hours correctly.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The height variation across the four pads is 0.016 millimeters, exceeding the coplanarity tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: All Z height reference pads within ±0.01 mm of each other?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Regrind or shim the low reference pads to restore coplanarity.

ground_truth.node_text: Regrind or shim low reference pads to restore coplanarity

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Low pads shimmed and coplanarity restored.

ground_truth.node_text: Regrind or shim low reference pads to restore coplanarity

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Place a precision spirit level on the angular datum face and record the deviation. Set up a sine bar at the nominal fixture angle and verify flush contact with no rocking.

ground_truth.node_text: Place a precision spirit level on the angular datum face and record the displayed deviation from level. Set up a sine bar at the nominal fixture angle and verify the angular datum contacts the sine bar face flush with no rocking. Record the angular deviation and compare against the angular tolerance in the fixture specification.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Angular measurements completed and recorded against specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Place a precision spirit level on the angular datum face and record the displayed deviation from level. Set up a sine bar at the nominal fixture angle and verify the angular datum contacts the sine bar face flush with no rocking. Record the angular deviation and compare against the angular tolerance in the fixture specification.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the angular datum within 0.005 millimeters per 100 millimeters tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Angular datum within 0.005 mm per 100 mm tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Angular datum is within tolerance at 0.003 millimeters per 100 millimeters.

ground_truth.node_text: Angular datum within 0.005 mm per 100 mm tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are all clamping forces within plus or minus 8 percent of nominal?

ground_truth.node_text: All clamping forces within ±8% of nominal?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All clamp stations read within 6 percent of nominal force.

ground_truth.node_text: All clamping forces within ±8% of nominal?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the thermal expansion datum shift within model prediction plus or minus 0.01 millimeters?

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal expansion datum shift within model prediction ±0.01 mm?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Thermal shift measures 0.008 millimeters, well within the model prediction.

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal expansion datum shift within model prediction ±0.01 mm?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the guide rail straightness within 0.01 millimeters per 300 millimeters?

ground_truth.node_text: Guide rail straightness within 0.01 mm per 300 mm?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The straightness looks okay, but I'm seeing significant wear grooves running along the entire length of the rail surface. The procedure doesn't say anything about checking for that.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Maximum gap reads 0.006 millimeters, within the straightness specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Guide rail straightness within 0.01 mm per 300 mm?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Have all lubrication points been serviced per schedule?

ground_truth.node_text: All lubrication points serviced per schedule?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I found two pivot pins that were missed during the last service cycle.

ground_truth.node_text: All lubrication points serviced per schedule?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Apply grease to the missed lubrication points.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply grease to missed lubrication points

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All missed lubrication points now serviced.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply grease to missed lubrication points

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Load the designated reference part into the fixture under normal production clamping force. Probe the part at the primary datum contact, the two secondary contact points, and the Z height reference surface. Compare all measurements against the qualification certificate values.

ground_truth.node_text: Load the designated reference part into the fixture under normal production clamping force. Probe the part at the primary datum contact, the two secondary contact points, and the Z height reference surface using the machine probing cycle. Record all four measured values and compare against the reference part qualification certificate values; deviations outside tolerance indicate fixture datum shift requiring root cause investigation.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Reference part loaded and all four datum points probed and recorded.

ground_truth.node_text: Load the designated reference part into the fixture under normal production clamping force. Probe the part at the primary datum contact, the two secondary contact points, and the Z height reference surface using the machine probing cycle. Record all four measured values and compare against the reference part qualification certificate values; deviations outside tolerance indicate fixture datum shift requiring root cause investigation.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the reference part positioned within plus or minus 0.02 millimeters of nominal at all datums?

ground_truth.node_text: Reference part positioned within ±0.02 mm of nominal at all datums?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The secondary contact point shows 0.027 millimeters deviation, outside tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Reference part positioned within ±0.02 mm of nominal at all datums?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. Escalate this fixture immediately for functional trial failure due to datum incompatibility. Do not return to production until root cause is identified and corrected.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: functional trial failed, datum incompatibility

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, escalating to engineering for datum incompatibility investigation.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: functional trial failed, datum incompatibility
